acanthus-initial-infill.description: The painted infill of a decorated initial from the text, a two-lobed field shaped like a B and outlined by a thin blue band. Inside it blue stems coil through both lobes and throw off red and violet acanthus leaves with cream-white folded tips, with the spaces between the leaves open. The letter stroke, its square field and the gold ground are removed; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

acanthus-initial-infill.quality: Worn paint, the blue band is broken in places and small flecks of the former gold ground remain between the leaves.
acanthus-initial-infill.title: Red and violet acanthus infill of an initial
usage_notes: Reads as a medallion on a plain ground; the open spaces between the leaves show whatever is behind it.

announcing-angel-with-blank-scroll.description: An angel with blond hair and a gold halo flies to the left on a bank of blue clouds edged in white, in a red robe, with long red wings sweeping back to the right over white feathered underwings, and holds a large blank white scroll that curls down in front of the clouds. Cut from the upper lobe of the miniature; the starry sky is removed and the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

announcing-angel-with-blank-scroll.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255 (invisible in use) and the cloud edges keep a soft fringe.
announcing-angel-with-blank-scroll.title: Angel on clouds with a blank scroll
usage_notes: Pairs with four-contacting-shepherds-with-dog-and-two-sheep, above which it hovers in the miniature; the scroll is blank and can carry a line of text.

annunciation-to-the-shepherds-miniature.description: The whole arched miniature of the leaf. In the upper lobe an angel in a red robe flies to the left on a bank of blue and white clouds under a deep blue sky with gold stars, holding a blank white scroll; a gold, red and blue diaper ground fills the spandrels. Below, four shepherds in red, blue and pink hooded tunics stand on a green meadow before a dark hill with two green trees and look up, a white dog leaps between them and two white sheep graze; a pink rock rises at the left. A gold and blue painted frame with an arched top encloses the scene. Opaque inside the frame, transparent outside.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

annunciation-to-the-shepherds-miniature.quality: The arched top is a physical cut edge with small parchment flecks along the gold rim, and the gold leaf of the frame is worn at the top.
annunciation-to-the-shepherds-miniature.title: Annunciation to the Shepherds, framed miniature
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out. The angel and the shepherd group are also supplied as separate cut-outs.
On the leaf it sits in the open top of fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy, above the text.

blue-bloom-on-red-stalk-a.description: A small sprig from the lower margin of the border. A blue cup-shaped bloom with a cream underside, its petals curling back to the right, sits on a tapering red stalk that points to the left. Painted in thick, speckled pigment; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

blue-bloom-on-red-stalk-a.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255, invisible in use.
blue-bloom-on-red-stalk-a.title: Blue bloom on a red stalk, lower margin left
usage_notes: One of the small blooms scattered along the bottom margin of fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy; small-right-red-and-blue-leaf-terminal is the other, both with the stalk pointing left.

blue-bloom-on-red-stalk-b.description: A small sprig from the lower margin of the border. A blue cup-shaped bloom with a cream underside at its base, its petals curling back to the right, sits on a tapering red stalk that points to the left. Painted in thick, speckled pigment; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

blue-bloom-on-red-stalk-b.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255, invisible in use.
blue-bloom-on-red-stalk-b.title: Blue bloom on a red stalk, lower margin right
usage_notes: One of the small blooms scattered along the bottom margin of fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy; small-left-red-and-blue-leaf-terminal is the other, both with the stalk pointing left.

corner.description: Top-left mitred corner, the round bloom of the tile set on the diagonal with the stem leaving to the right and downward; cut from the tile itself, not from one of the leaf's painted corners.

blue-cornflower-chain-tile.description: One cycle of the cornflower chain that forms the vertical stems of the border. A blue fan-shaped bloom seen from the side sits above a round blue bloom seen from the front, both with pale-blue ribbed petals, threaded on a green stem that runs through the tile from top to bottom. The stem continues across the top and bottom edges; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

blue-cornflower-chain-tile.quality: Native width is 262 px, so it softens above native size; the bloom edges keep a soft fringe at partial alpha.
blue-cornflower-chain-tile.title: Blue cornflower chain, repeat tile
usage_notes: Repeats along y for a vertical chain; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal one.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with the mitred corner; use it with border-image and round fitting. The leaf's own corners are large plants, supplied as separate cut-outs.
Keep it near native size; the cycle is 262 px wide and softens when enlarged.

flowered-u-page-border.description: The complete painted border of the leaf, open at the top where the miniature sat. Two vertical chains of blue cornflowers on a green stem are joined by a third along the bottom, over a loose ground of gold ivy leaves and dots on fine black penwork. Large plants fill the corners, a red and blue acanthus with a gold bird at the top left, a pot of pink flowers at the top right, a leafy pink-flowered branch at the bottom left and a clump of blue cornflowers at the bottom right; a gray-blue acanthus scroll and a second red acanthus grow from the left margin. Centre and background are transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

flowered-u-page-border.quality: The left and right sides are cut flat at the trimmed page edges, clipping the outer acanthus and leaf tips; the gold leaf of the ivy is worn, and a few stray gold specks of the ground remain near the right edge.
flowered-u-page-border.title: Flowered U-shaped page border with gold ivy
usage_notes: Fixed page border scaled as a whole; it is open at the top, so a heading or picture goes in the gap and text inside the U. It is not a border-image, the four corners all differ and the chains are not evenly spaced.
For a cornflower chain at any length use blue-cup-and-burst-flowers-on-stem; the four corner plants, the margin scroll and the two small blooms are supplied as separate cut-outs.

four-contacting-shepherds-with-dog-and-t.description: Four shepherds stand in a close group looking up at the sky. From the left, a bearded man in a blue hood and red tunic with a staff over his shoulder, a youth in a pink tunic, a man in a red hood and blue tunic holding a long staff, and a bearded man in a blue hood and red tunic striped in gold, leaning on a crook and gesturing. A white dog leaps up between them and two white sheep graze at their feet; hose in blue, red and pink, black shoes. Cut from the miniature; the meadow and hill are removed and the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

four-contacting-shepherds-with-dog-and-t.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255, invisible in use.
four-contacting-shepherds-with-dog-and-t.title: Four shepherds with a dog and two sheep
usage_notes: The shepherds look up and to the left; pair the group with announcing-angel-with-blank-scroll placed above it, as in the miniature.

left-gray-blue-acanthus-scroll-with-gree.description: A tall acanthus sprig from the left margin of the border. A gray-blue stem rises from a round pink bud at the bottom, which sprouts a short green stalk to the right, and curls twice to the right into dotted gray-blue scrolls, each carrying a green leaf. The stem is cut flat at the left where the page was trimmed; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

left-gray-blue-acanthus-scroll-with-gree.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255 (invisible in use), and the left edge of the stem is a flat cut at the page edge.
left-gray-blue-acanthus-scroll-with-gree.title: Gray-blue acanthus scroll with a pink bud
usage_notes: Vertical margin sprig; it sits on the outer side of the chain in fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy, with the scrolls turning in towards the text.

long-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar.description: A long horizontal line filler from the text, a worn band of gold leaf over a strip of blue paint with small curled hooks at the ends, made of three short segments set end to end with narrow gaps between them. The gold is cracked and partly bare and the blue mottled, as painted; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

long-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar.quality: Original paint loss, the gold is flaked down to the ground in places, and the edges are feathered at partial alpha.
long-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar.title: Blue and gold line filler, long
usage_notes: Fills the end of a text line; scale it to the line height with the gold band at the top. short-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar is the one-segment version.

lower-left-green-leaf-branch-with-pink-f.description: The bottom-left corner plant of the border. Slender green stems with oval leaves fan up and to the right and carry four pink trumpet-shaped flowers with fringed, darker pink rims on green calyxes; a smaller leafy shoot sits at the bottom left. The paint is thin, with the parchment tone showing through the green; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

lower-left-green-leaf-branch-with-pink-f.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255 (invisible in use) and the thin green paint keeps the parchment tone.
lower-left-green-leaf-branch-with-pink-f.title: Leafy branch with pink trumpet flowers
usage_notes: Bottom-left corner plant; lower-right-green-leaf-branch-with-blue-flowers is its counterpart at the other end of the bottom margin.

lower-right-green-leaf-branch-with-blue-.description: The bottom-right corner plant of the border, a clump of blue cornflowers. Five fringed blue blooms, three seen from the side and two from the front, one with a small yellow centre, grow on tall green stems with narrow leaves and two green buds, rising from a mound of grass at the bottom. The paint is thin, with the parchment tone showing through the green; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

lower-right-green-leaf-branch-with-blue-.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255 (invisible in use) and the thin green paint keeps the parchment tone.
lower-right-green-leaf-branch-with-blue-.title: Clump of blue cornflowers on tall stems
usage_notes: Bottom-right corner plant, standing on its own grassy base; lower-left-green-leaf-branch-with-pink-flowers is its counterpart at the other end of the bottom margin.

short-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar.description: A short horizontal line filler from the text, a worn band of gold leaf over a strip of blue paint, with a curled hook turning up at the right end and a few blue flecks above the band. The gold is cracked and the blue mottled, as painted; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

short-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar.quality: Original paint loss and feathered edges at partial alpha; the flecks above the band are loose fragments of the paint.
short-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar.title: Blue and gold line filler, short
usage_notes: Fills the end of a text line; scale it to the line height with the gold band at the top. long-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar is the three-segment version.

small-blue-and-gold-four-point-line-end-.description: A tiny four-pointed floret of gold leaf with blue paint between the arms, of the kind that closes a short text line. The gold is lumpy and cracked and the outline is soft; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

small-blue-and-gold-four-point-line-end-.quality: Only 131 px square, so it blurs when enlarged, and the outline is soft at partial alpha.
small-blue-and-gold-four-point-line-end-.title: Blue and gold line-end floret
usage_notes: Use at text size as a line-end mark or bullet; the two line-filler bars are its companions from the same text block.

upper-left-red-and-blue-acanthus-branch.description: The top-left corner plant of the border. From a pink bud with a blue calyx at the bottom, red and blue acanthus stems fan upward and out to both sides, their leaves curling into dotted scrolls, the right-hand stem ending in a green knot with a red tip. A small gold bird perches on the left stem facing left. The paint is thick and speckled; the leftmost leaves are cut flat at the trimmed page edge. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

upper-left-red-and-blue-acanthus-branch.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255 (invisible in use), and the left edge is a flat cut at the page edge.
upper-left-red-and-blue-acanthus-branch.title: Red and blue acanthus branch with a gold bird
usage_notes: Top-left corner plant; the bud at the bottom is where the border's vertical chain starts, so it sits naturally on top of a vertical run of blue-cup-and-burst-flowers-on-stem. upper-right-pink-flowers-on-green-leaf-sprays is its counterpart at the other top corner.

upper-right-pink-flowers-on-green-leaf-s.description: The top-right corner plant of the border. A bushy plant of long, ribbed green leaves spreads from an orange-red pot and carries four pinkish-violet four-petalled flowers along the top and a pink bud at the right; under the pot a blue cornflower bloom marks where the border's vertical chain begins. The green is thin and speckled with the parchment tone; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

upper-right-pink-flowers-on-green-leaf-s.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the interior sits at alpha 252–253 rather than 255 (invisible in use) and the thin green paint keeps the parchment tone.
upper-right-pink-flowers-on-green-leaf-s.title: Potted plant with pink four-petalled flowers
usage_notes: Top-right corner plant; the cornflower under the pot lets it sit on top of a vertical run of blue-cup-and-burst-flowers-on-stem. upper-left-red-and-blue-acanthus-branch is its counterpart at the other top corner.
